facts.text: Controller opens the Teensy serial link with ArCOMObject(port, 115200)
The olfactometer has eight valves: the leftmost bit of the binary string is Valve 1 and the rightmost bit is Valve 8
set_all_olfactometer_valves asserts an eight-character pattern, reverses it and sends its decimal value as a uint8
open_olfactometer sends the smell command, the open letter and the valve number as a uint8
close_olfactometer sends the smell command, the close letter and the valve number as a uint8
A laser amplitude is a float between 0 and 1 V
_amp2int clips the amplitude to 0 to 1 and scales it to an integer between 0 and 100
turn_on_laser writes the letter o twice and the scaled amplitude; turn_off_laser writes o then x and the scaled amplitude
set_gpio accepts pins 0 to 7 (pins = list(range(8))) and the modes pulse, high and low
start_camera_trig sends the auxiliary begin command and an integer frame rate; stop_camera_trig sends the auxiliary end command and 0
block_until_read waits until a reply byte is available and then reads one uint8
set_all_olfactometer_valves waits through wait_for_response, whose default timeout is 10 seconds
start_camera_trig and stop_camera_trig send their command and return without waiting for a reply byte
